author_note: Checked by hand against the Spanish source. Bulgarian is the language this benchmark exists because of: models trained mostly on Russian answer in Russian-shaped text for any Slavic target, and every mechanical check passes while they do it.

checks.label: te amo -> обичам те
checks.why: The whole line is a declaration of love; losing it loses the segment

checks.label: Mother's Day
checks.why: Майчин ден and Ден на майката are both correct. 'День' is Russian and 'матица' is not a word

checks.label: hola -> здравей
checks.why: A greeting the viewer hears at the top of the clip

checks.label: cómo estás -> как си
checks.why: A direct question to the mother

checks.label: best mom in the world
checks.why: 'на свет' is Russian; Bulgarian is 'на света'

checks.label: Mother's Day
checks.why: Second occurrence; models that get it wrong get it wrong twice

checks.label: te extraño -> липсва
checks.why: 'скучам по' is a Russian calque; Bulgarian is 'липсваш ми'

checks.label: adiós -> a real farewell
checks.why: 'До слагание' is a mangling of the Russian 'До свидания' and means nothing

checks.label: disfrutes este día
checks.why: A wish for the day. The stem must be 'насла', not 'наслад' — Bulgarian has both насладиш and наслаждавай, and matching only the first marks a correct translation wrong

penalties.label: clitic opens a clause
penalties.why: Bulgarian clitics cannot open a clause: 'Обичам те много' or 'Много те обичам', never 'Те обичам много'. Models transfer the Russian order

penalties.label: Russian vocabulary
penalties.why: Words that are Russian, not Bulgarian — the tell that a model is leaning on its Russian training data
